default_toml.why: sets the sender and Reply-To in config/default.toml, the obvious file, which local.toml overrides

example_toml.why: sets the sender and Reply-To in config/example.toml, which nothing reads

sender_in_code.why: hard-codes the sender and Reply-To in mailer.build instead of finding the config file that decides

reply_to_key.why: sets the sender in local.toml but the Reply-To under a reply-to key mailer.build never reads
